evals.prompt: Lint the vault at evals/fixture-vault (its live policy is Guideline.md). Are the frontmatter keys in alphabetical order everywhere?
evals.expected_output: Reports Key Order.md with each out-of-order pair and its line; reports no other note for key order.
expectations: The report lists Knowledge/Broken/Key Order.md line 3 as `type > aliases`
The report lists Knowledge/Broken/Key Order.md line 7 as `tags > layer`
No other note is reported for key order
No file in the vault was modified; the fix is routed to the Obsidian Linter plugin

evals.prompt: Check evals/fixture-vault for external URLs in wiki-page frontmatter that are not under a *_url key, *_url values that are not plain URLs, and the retired youtube and x keys.
evals.expected_output: Reports the non-plain blog_url value, every URL under source and website, and the two retired keys in URL Keys.md; `url` as the homepage, youtube_url and the Raw note's plain URL under source are not reported.
expectations: blog_url is reported because its value is a markdown link, not a plain URL
website and both source items (the [label](URL) citation and the plain URL) are reported as URLs outside a *_url key
The x and youtube keys are reported as retired keys
url: https://example.com and youtube_url are not reported
Lumen Notes.md, Northwind Labs.md and Jane Doe.md (url, x_url, youtube_url, linkedin_url) are not reported
The Raw note's `source: <URL>` is not reported: URL placement is checked on wiki pages

evals.prompt: Does any note body in evals/fixture-vault contain a raw URL instead of a [label](URL) link?
evals.expected_output: Reports the bare URL in Bare URL.md from link-lint.py; the same URL as a [label](URL) link on the next paragraph is fine.
expectations: The report lists BARE-URL for Knowledge/Broken/Bare URL.md line 10
The labelled link on line 12 is not reported
The finding comes from scripts/link-lint.py, not from judgment

evals.prompt: In evals/fixture-vault, find Entity names (titles or aliases of pages with layer: entities) that appear without [[ ]] in wiki pages, in the body or in frontmatter.
evals.expected_output: Reports the two frontmatter values and the two first body mentions in Unlinked Entity.md, each with the page it should link.
expectations: organization: Northwind Labs is reported with [[Northwind Labs]] as the target
related: J. Doe is reported as an alias of [[Jane Doe]]
The body mentions Lumen (an alias of Lumen Notes) and Northwind Labs on line 14 are reported
Jane Doe on line 16 is not reported because the body already links [[Jane Doe]]
Mentions in inline code, a link label and a heading are not reported
Plain mentions in the Sources/ Raw note and the Projects/ work note are not reported (only the wiki role is checked)
A mention inside a quote block (Spaced Repetition.md) is not reported
A mention in a tab-indented nested list item (Horizontal Rule.md line 33) is reported: it is not indented code
A mention in a lazy continuation line of a quote is not reported

evals.prompt: Which notes in evals/fixture-vault carry a status key even though the guideline says only lifecycle notes may?
evals.expected_output: Reads the lifecycle types (project, task) from Guideline.md and reports the concept page, the Raw note and the plain work note; the project note keeps its status.
expectations: The lifecycle types are taken from Guideline.md, not assumed
Knowledge/Broken/Status On Concept.md, Sources/2026-11-21 Northwind Labs hiring post.md and Projects/2026-11-24 Weekly Review.md are reported
Projects/Lumen Notes Trial.md (type: project) is not reported
Lint does not suggest adding status to any note

evals.prompt: Find horizontal rules in wiki page bodies in evals/fixture-vault.
evals.expected_output: Reports the --- and *** rules in Horizontal Rule.md; the --- inside its code block, the frontmatter fences and the rules in the Raw and work notes are not reported.
expectations: Knowledge/Broken/Horizontal Rule.md lines 12 and 16 are reported
The --- inside the code block is not reported
Sources/2026-11-20 Lumen Notes launch post.md and Projects/Lumen Notes Trial.md are not reported, because they are not in the wiki role
The `---` under a two-line paragraph (a setext heading underline) and the `---` inside indented code are not reported

evals.prompt: Are there any leftover append-only auto zones (## Wiki or ## From Sources) in wiki pages of evals/fixture-vault?
evals.expected_output: Reports both headings in Auto Zone.md.
expectations: Knowledge/Broken/Auto Zone.md line 12 `## Wiki` and line 16 `## From Sources` are reported
The report does not rewrite the page body; it names the fix (drop the heading line, promote the headings under it) for the owner

evals.prompt: Check evals/fixture-vault for notes that repeat a heading.
evals.expected_output: Reports the second ## Notes in Duplicate Heading.md.
expectations: Knowledge/Broken/Duplicate Heading.md line 14 is reported
marksman-lint.py reports it from the document symbols as well

evals.prompt: List wikilinks in note bodies of evals/fixture-vault whose target note does not exist.
evals.expected_output: link-lint.py reports [[Missing Page]] in Broken Link.md; every other body wikilink resolves.
expectations: Knowledge/Broken/Broken Link.md line 12 [[Missing Page]] is reported as BROKEN
Links to the Raw note by its dated title are not reported

evals.prompt: Check evals/fixture-vault for links to headings that do not exist in the target note.
evals.expected_output: marksman-lint.py reports [[Backlink#Missing Heading]] in Broken Link.md.
expectations: Knowledge/Broken/Broken Link.md line 14 is reported as BROKEN-HEADING
The links to existing notes without a heading are not reported

evals.prompt: Do any frontmatter link fields in evals/fixture-vault point at notes that do not exist?
evals.expected_output: With Obsidian running on the fixture, obsidian-lint.py reports [[Missing Related]] under related in Broken Link.md; offline, the PyYAML recipe in references/checks.md covers it.
expectations: Knowledge/Broken/Broken Link.md line 4 related: [[Missing Related]] is reported as BROKEN
source and related links that resolve are not reported

evals.prompt: Some notes in evals/fixture-vault show no properties in Obsidian. Which ones have frontmatter that does not parse?
evals.expected_output: Reports Invalid Frontmatter.md, whose repeated status key makes the YAML invalid, and runs no other frontmatter check on it.
expectations: Knowledge/Broken/Invalid Frontmatter.md is reported as FM-INVALID on line 1
Its repeated status key is not also reported as STATUS-NOT-LIFECYCLE or FM-KEY-ORDER

evals.prompt: Run the scripted checks of lint (link form, frontmatter and structure, marksman) over evals/fixture-vault and tell me which notes they leave clean.
evals.expected_output: No scripted finding for the sample pages: the person, organization, product, term, concept, Raw, project note, MOC and guideline.
expectations: None of the clean files has a finding from link-lint.py, marksman-lint.py or obsidian-lint.py
The person page with authorship: user and the owner's impressions gets no finding (moving impressions is not a lint check)

evals.prompt: lint evals/fixture-vault and fix whatever frontmatter problems you find
evals.expected_output: Runs the checks and reports every finding without editing any note; routes frontmatter fixes (key order, URL keys, status) to the Obsidian Linter plugin and body fixes to the owner or the writing skill.
expectations: Wiki, source and work folders and the lifecycle types are read from Guideline.md, not assumed
Obsidian CLI is used only if Obsidian already has the fixture vault open; otherwise link-lint.py --checks policy runs and the report says which path ran
No note in evals/fixture-vault is modified, and no wiki log entry is written
The report names the Obsidian Linter plugin for key order and other frontmatter fixes
